title: Husband Beater is Convinced That Laws Don’t Apply To Her
description:
On June 4th, 2023, officers responded to a case of domestic violence. The victim had locked himself in the bedroom due to threats from his wife. Here’s what the husband told the police about the whole incident. The woman continued to defend her side even after being arrested. The husband explained how this incident keeps happening repeatedly. He showed the officers a recording of the woman acting dangerously. The woman kept complaining about her relationship to the officer. The female was soon transported to the jail for further investigation. The woman started acting very difficult as soon as they arrived at the jail. The female was charged with domestic violence, resisting arrest and aggravated menacing.
